scope: Proposition 9.2 of the manuscript “Metric descent and rank-preserving contractions” (preprints/Metric-descent-and-rank-preserving-contractions-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 35f14f53ac82dc8a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 51-52. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: Keep the fixed-section data of Section 8.3 and assume H0(Y, Ωq Y ) = 0 for q > 0. After taking a power of s, let D, D∗ be integral, put G = D∗ − D ≥ 0, and let N be the 51 reduced omitted-prime divisor. Suppose D has a bounded semipositive metric and that every cotangent line has nonpositive degree against every movable class annihilating N. If there is no invariant global section of a positive multiple of L, a smaller base preserving an invariant generic section of a positive multiple of L and the original-prime uniqueness condition is obtained from one of the systems |mD + iM + kG + lN|, m, i, k, l ∈ Z≥0, where M is a single cotangent determinant line and H0(Y, M + mjD) ̸= 0 for unbounded positive mj.
